honesty: Educational grape climate preference models for Vineyard Intelligence. Not site-certified agronomy advice. Future-decade projections are scenario estimates.

grapes.name: Cabernet Sauvignon
grapes.notes: Needs sufficient heat to ripen thick skins; excess heat can push alcohol and soften freshness.

grapes.name: Pinot Noir
grapes.notes: Prefers cooler seasons; rising summer heat and humidity often increase stress and disease pressure.

grapes.name: Chardonnay
grapes.notes: Wide stylistic range; cooler sites keep tension, warmer sites deepen body.

grapes.name: Riesling
grapes.notes: Nighttime cooling and retained acidity support long-term suitability in many warming scenarios.

grapes.name: Merlot
grapes.notes: Earlier ripening than Cabernet can help in shorter seasons.

grapes.name: Cabernet Franc
grapes.notes: Often a resilient bridge grape between cool and warm regimes.
